research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mist Systems is focused on enhancing wireless communication devices by simulating beacon signals even when none are transmitted or received. Their approach involves methods and apparatuses that enable devices to interact as though beacon signals are present, optimizing the functionality of intelligent wireless networks and leveraging machine learning capabilities. This innovation underscores Mist Systems' commitment to advancing wireless platform technologies in the Smart Device era.

overview_description.description:
Mist Systems, born in the mobile and cloud era, delivers the world’s first intelligent wireless network products that leverage machine learning. Using Mist, enterprises can provide amazing user experiences not possible before, and IT can proactively manage the network at any scale.

It was founded in 2014 and is based in Cupertino, California.
